scientific_integrity: A complete analytic proof and reproducibility checker are supplied; finite checker output is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The sharp 11/4 bound and fixed-leg profile concern symmetric nondegenerate trapezoids with two opposite unit-strutted legs, not arbitrary convex quadrilaterals; witnesses lie in the closed polygon and may be vertices. The fixed-leg profile requires 0<a<1. Novelty is assessed against accessible literature and is not an independently established priority fact.
title: Sharp perimeter profile for opposite unit-strutted legs of symmetric trapezoids
